title: Unraveling the Allosteric Mechanism of Four Cancer-related Mutations in the Disruption of p53-DNA Interaction.
authors: Tang, Yiming; Yao, Yifei; Wei, Guanghong
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级MD模拟和网络分析，系统研究了p53肿瘤抑制因子DBD中四个癌症相关突变如何通过别构机制破坏p53-DNA相互作用，属于典型的TF-DNA互作动态机制研究，与课题高度匹配。
abstract: The p53 protein plays active roles in the physiological regulation of cell cycle as well as in cancer developments. In more than half of human cancers, the protein is inactivated by mutations located primarily in its DNA-binding domain (DBD), and some mutations located in the beta-sandwich region of DBD are reported to decrease p53-DNA binding affinities. To understand the long-range correlation between p53 beta-sandwich and DNA, and the allosteric mechanism of beta-sandwich mutations in the disruption of p53-DNA interactions, we first identify three regions with a strong correlation with DNA based on microsecond molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of wild-type p53-DNA complex and then perform multiple MD simulations on four cancer-related mutants L145Q, P151S, Y220C, and G266R, which are located in these three regions. Our simulations show that these mutations allosterically destabilize the structural stability of the DNA-binding groove in p53 and disrupt the p53-DNA interactions. Network analyses reveal optimal correlation paths through which the mutation-induced allosteric signal passes to DNA, and the disturbance effect of these mutations on the global connectivity and dynamical correlation of the p53-DNA complex. This work paves the way for the in-depth understanding of the mutation-induced loss in p53's DNA-recognition ability and the pathological mechanism of cancer development.
abstract_zh: p53蛋白在细胞周期的生理调控及癌症发展中发挥积极作用。在超过半数的人类癌症中，该蛋白因主要位于其DNA结合域（DBD）的突变而失活，且据报道，位于DBD的β-三明治区域的一些突变会降低p53-DNA结合亲和力。为了理解p53β-三明治与DNA之间的长程相关性，以及β-三明治突变破坏p53-DNA相互作用的变构机制，我们首先基于野生型p53-DNA复合物的微秒级分子动力学（MD）模拟，识别出三个与DNA强相关的区域，然后对位于这三个区域的四个癌症相关突变体L145Q、P151S、Y220C和G266R进行多次MD模拟。我们的模拟表明，这些突变变构性地 destabilize p53中DNA结合槽的结构稳定性，并破坏p53-DNA相互作用。网络分析揭示了突变诱导的变构信号传递至DNA的最优相关路径，以及这些突变对p53-DNA复合物全局连接性和动态相关性的干扰效应。这项工作为深入理解突变导致的p53 DNA识别能力丧失及癌症发展的病理机制铺平了道路。
